scope: One canonical base plus 17 complete cat-with-one-accessory models. No combination-generation stage in this phase.
methods: Reference-led Blender modeling and fit repair
Image generation for worn-cat design and material sources
Meshy complete-worn-cat API when needed; review against canonical cat
identityRules: Fixed visible cat proportions, face, pose and tail across variants
Only physically covered/compressed regions may change, with a recorded mask or vertex region
Match camera and scale before comparing
Old reference sets are design guidance, not proof of identity with the v9 base
If the approved base itself needs a body/fur correction, version that canonical repair and re-apply it consistently to every accessory variant rather than independently redesigning each cat.
physicalRules: No unexplained floating, detached layers, body intersections or duplicated decorations
Covered ears stay folded inside hats
Scarf wraps have width, thickness, folds and gravity-consistent tails
Each clip/brooch stays at a fixed anatomical attachment; opposite views obey occlusion
Backpack straps, bow fasteners, eyeglass temples and hanging pieces have real connections
productionStages: fresh GLB import and material/geometry preservation check
internal visual acceptance with retained evidence

limitations: No standing/full-body locomotion; current stretch remains seated.
No multi-accessory combination in this phase.
Original v9 face texture specks and smooth back retained.

items.design: A slim soft midnight-navy collar nested into the neck fur, with one small polished gold bell centered at the front and a physically connected short loop.
items.physics: Continuous collar around the neck; the bell remains front-center, hangs downward, and is hidden by the body from the back except for the rear collar band.
items.reviewNotes: Internal visual review: static 360/high/low GLB views, 20 Blender deformation views, and 5 browser views inspected. Runtime actions and exact still recovery verified. Not additional user design approval. Published on both sites as v266; user review remains separate.
